verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has an official V3 REST API with PHP SDK CRUD examples. Intuit's official MCP server exposes full CRUD on 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, so a large share of core bookkeeping data is programmatically reachable. However, nothing documents parity with the UI, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent: bank reconciliation, payroll, forecasting, Intuit Intelligence, and custom roles and workflows. The '29 entity types' scope suggests a subset of the product, not everything. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity statement, API coverage of reconciliation, payroll, forecasting and AI features, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: PHP client for connecting to the QuickBooks Online V3 REST API.
It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
29 Entity Types - Full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete, Search)
145 Total Tools - Complete coverage of QuickBooks Online API
